about_the_game:
🌀 A massive world where madness meets romance!

🌌 1000+ jaw-dropping artworks & scenes!

🎭 20+ main characters !

📖 30+ hours of story in the full release!

🎮 FREE DEMO: 2-3hr standalone story that’ll blow your socks off!

Welcome to CELL

Welcome to CELL — a living city that grows, breathes, and whispers your darkest cravings into reality.

Every soul that steps inside is gifted with powers... and equally unexpected curses.

But don’t panic! We’ve got a 360° security system to keep the chaos just tolerable enough.

 

In CELL, your daily life includes:

So what’s the price of paradise? Go ahead, take a wild guess.

Cheractor

She just arrived in CELL… and the city instantly labeled her a monster. Now she runs for her life.

A girl, who belongs to the brutal peacekeeping patrol of CELL, refuse her duty and lock herself in robot.

In a city where cutting in line means death by law, one woman persists in pursuing judicial justice with an idealistic fervor.

So, how will your paths cross? Will you fight, flirt, or flee? Or all of the above?

From the Devs

We are a narrative-driven game studio, creators of the indie game GhostFeed. Inspired by epic stories like Fate/stay night and Steins;Gate, and deeply moved by EVA's visual storytelling, we craft immersive worlds in this spirit. This project was developed using the Wansei Xingchen Editor, boosting our workflow efficiency. We hope you enjoy this new chapter.
